content:
Successful HWPX document generation requires precise XML namespace handling, placeholder reassembly across split tags, and layout cache invalidation.
The implementation used ET.register_namespace to preserve HWPX-specific tags and reassembled text across multiple <hp:t> elements within <hp:p> containers. Layout artifacts in <hp:lineSegArray> were removed to force viewer re-rendering after text replacement. The final ZIP archive ensured the 'mimetype' file was the first entry and stored without compression (method 0) for OCF compliance.
